# motion-design

> Agent skill. Turns a product, website, or brand into a 15–25s launch film.

The human README is /README.md. The skill the model should load is /skills/motion-design/SKILL.md.

## For agents

- Install: copy /skills/motion-design into the agent's skills directory, or `npx skills add https://github.com/Detoy/motion-design --skill motion-design`
- Entry: skills/motion-design/SKILL.md
- Map: /AGENTS.md
- Do not skip the critique loop in skills/motion-design/references/critique.md
- Renderer: skills/motion-design/scripts/render-frames.mjs
- Springs: skills/motion-design/assets/motion.js

## Optional reads

- skills/motion-design/references/inspect.md
- skills/motion-design/references/plan.md
- skills/motion-design/references/engine.md
- skills/motion-design/references/motion.md
- skills/motion-design/references/sound.md
- skills/motion-design/references/tones.md
